item.content:encoded:
Doing aesthetic stuff in HTML is unfortunately out of my area of expertise, and I would be hesitant regardless to do much that distracts from the story. That's partially the reason the article itself isn't very hook-y, it's more of an introduction than something intended to stand on its own in this case.

I'll admit that the second sample of text doesn't relate to anything in the rest of the text very strongly. There's more of a connection than there was in earlier drafting, but it's still pretty weak. I'll edit it if something comes to me, but I was stuck between wanting to preserve the rule of three and a corner I wrote myself into regarding chapters referring to different things.

Thanks for the feedback!
